{{Top|leg}}
The '''Kreedle Precinct''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. Its notable locations included [[Sachet Springs]], a water park known for its natural beauty, water-sport facilities, and campsites; the [[Javat Caridan Environment]] and the [[Javat Caridan Children's Animal Habitat]], a preserve for endangered [[Carida|Caridan]] species; and [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]], an abandoned government facility that served as a hideout for freedom fighters during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
